# arche

> From zero toward frontier-ready—one path. Hand-write a Llama 3.2–style dense LLM (running example ~1B), train weights, serve faster, then map MoE/MLA-style structures. Bilingual EN / 简体中文。By chaxus (https://chaxus.com/).

arche is a beginner curriculum plus companion Python labs. Site UI is Vite + ranui. One spine: grow tables → **next-token train** → hand-write dense bricks → align → serve → frontier maps (DeepSeek-shaped MoE+MLA). Llama 3.2 ~1B is the continuous dense example.

## Docs

- [Home (English)](https://arche.chaxus.com/): curriculum home and path overview
- [首页（简体中文）](https://arche.chaxus.com/cn/): 中文首页与路径总览
- [Full text for AI](https://arche.chaxus.com/llms-full.txt): chapter bodies concatenated for retrieval / grounding

## Optional

- [GitHub](https://github.com/chaxus/arche): source, labs, and site
- [Sitemap](https://arche.chaxus.com/sitemap.xml): every EN/CN chapter URL

## Notes

Prefer citing a specific chapter URL (trailing slash) over the home page when answering curriculum questions. Chinese pages live under `/cn/`. Legacy `?c=` query links redirect to path URLs in the browser.
